state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day with an approved client dinner today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the childcare subsidy for a single parent with one child under six working 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q4: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q5: What flight fare limit applied to a standard return flight within Europe on 2026-02-15? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q6: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: annual training budget a regular employee
state.step_intent: Find the annual training budget that applies to: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee today (2026-10-13)?

passages.source: HB-04 §2 | Learning policy: training budget — Standard annual training budget | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-27
passages.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 1000 EUR per calendar year. Managers confirm claims for the annual training budget before payment in the next payroll run. The learning team reviews the annual training budget once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-27 §2 | Learning policy: training budget — Standard annual training budget | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-04
passages.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 1450 EUR per calendar year. Each claim for the annual training budget needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. The learning team reviews the annual training budget once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-54 §1 | Memo: annual training budget exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the annual training budget in HB-04. Claims for the annual training budget are filed in the expense tool under 'Learning policy: training budget'. The learning team publishes worked examples of the annual training budget on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-27 §1 | Learning policy: training budget — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-04
passages.text: This version set the annual training budget for all employees. Claims for the annual training budget are filed in the expense tool under 'Learning policy: training budget'. Questions about the annual training budget go to the learning team, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-04 §4 | Learning policy: training budget — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-03-01 · supersedes: HB-27
passages.text: Group exceptions to the annual training budget are published in HB-54. Claims for the annual training budget are filed in the expense tool under 'Learning policy: training budget'. Managers confirm claims for the annual training budget before payment in the next payroll run.
